name: MidiSynthPlayer
fullName: Algorithmic FM & Chiptune MIDI Soundtrack Engine
description: Lightweight zero-sample procedural music synthesizer and .mid playback engine for GDevelop 5. Plays standard MIDI files using 100% mathematical FM and chiptune synthesis in real time with 0 KB audio sample downloads.
shortDescription: Procedural FM & Chiptune MIDI soundtrack synthesizer engine (0 KB samples).
author: Twillion

eventsFunctions.name: PlayMidi
eventsFunctions.description: Starts real-time algorithmic synthesis playback of a standard .mid soundtrack.

eventsFunctions.name: StopMidi
eventsFunctions.description: Immediately stops MIDI music and releases all active synthesizer voices.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseMidi
eventsFunctions.description: Pauses MIDI music at current position.

eventsFunctions.name: ResumeMidi
eventsFunctions.description: Resumes MIDI music from paused position.

eventsFunctions.name: SeekMidi
eventsFunctions.description: Jumps to a specific timestamp in the MIDI song.

eventsFunctions.name: SetMasterVolume
eventsFunctions.description: Sets global synthesizer output volume (0 - 100).

eventsFunctions.name: SetChannelMuted
eventsFunctions.description: Mutes or unmutes a specific MIDI channel (0-15, Channel 9 is Drums) for dynamic interactive combat/stealth stems.

eventsFunctions.name: SetChannelVolume
eventsFunctions.description: Adjusts individual instrument channel volume (0 - 100).

eventsFunctions.name: SoloChannel
eventsFunctions.description: Mutes all channels except the selected channel.

eventsFunctions.name: UnmuteAllChannels
eventsFunctions.description: Restores all 16 MIDI channels to full playback.

eventsFunctions.name: SetChannelInstrument
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the General MIDI instrument program number (0-127) for a specific channel.

parameters.name: Program
parameters.description: Instrument Program Number (0-127, e.g. 0=Piano, 29=Distortion Guitar, 33=Finger Bass)

eventsFunctions.name: PlayNote
eventsFunctions.sentence: Play note _PARAM1_ on channel _PARAM0_ (Velocity: _PARAM2_, Duration: _PARAM3_ s)
eventsFunctions.description: Triggers an algorithmic synthesizer note or drum on demand for procedural sound effects, jingles, or live gameplay.

parameters.name: Note
parameters.description: MIDI Note Number (0-127, Middle C = 60, Kick = 36)

eventsFunctions.name: SetTempoMultiplier
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically speeds up or slows down playback without altering pitch (0.25 - 4.0).

eventsFunctions.name: Transpose
eventsFunctions.description: Shifts musical key in real-time (-24 to +24 semitones) on the fly.

parameters.name: Semitones
parameters.description: Pitch Transposition (+2 for whole step, -12 for octave down)

eventsFunctions.name: SetLowpassCutoff
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set master lowpass filter cutoff to _PARAM0_ Hz
eventsFunctions.description: Muffles or opens music brightness (e.g. 800 Hz for underwater / low health).

eventsFunctions.name: SetFilterResonance
eventsFunctions.description: Sets master filter resonance Q peak (0.1 - 25.0).

eventsFunctions.name: SetSoundChipProfile
eventsFunctions.description: Switches synthesizer retro sound flavor (OPL3 DOS, Sega Genesis FM, PC-98, NES Chiptune).

eventsFunctions.name: AttachSpatialObject
eventsFunctions.description: Anchors MIDI soundtrack synthesis to a 3D/2D object in space with distance attenuation.

eventsFunctions.name: DetachSpatial
eventsFunctions.description: Returns MIDI soundtrack to 2D master stereo output.

eventsFunctions.name: IsPlaying
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if a MIDI soundtrack is actively playing.

eventsFunctions.name: IsPaused
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if MIDI soundtrack playback is paused.

eventsFunctions.name: IsChannelMuted
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if a specific MIDI channel (0-15) is muted.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentTimeGreater
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if MIDI playback has progressed past the specified timestamp.

eventsFunctions.name: TempoGreater
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if current tempo exceeds the specified Beats Per Minute.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentTime
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current MIDI playback position in seconds.

eventsFunctions.name: TotalDuration
eventsFunctions.description: Returns total song duration in seconds.

eventsFunctions.name: BPM
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current song tempo in Beats Per Minute.

eventsFunctions.name: TempoMultiplier
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current playback speed multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: Transposition
eventsFunctions.description: Returns active pitch transposition in semitones.

eventsFunctions.name: ActiveVoiceCount
eventsFunctions.description: Returns number of simultaneous active polyphonic synth voices sounding.

eventsFunctions.name: MasterVolume
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current master output volume (0-100).

eventsFunctions.name: ChannelVolume
eventsFunctions.description: Returns volume of a specific MIDI channel (0-15).

eventsFunctions.name: ChannelInstrument
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the General MIDI instrument program number (0-127) assigned to a channel.

eventsFunctions.name: InstrumentName
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the standard General MIDI instrument name for a program number (0-127).

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: MidiSpatialEmitter
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Anchors zero-sample procedural MIDI soundtrack synthesis to this object in 3D/2D space with real-time distance attenuation.

propertyDescriptors.name: MasterVolume
propertyDescriptors.label: Master Volume (0-100)
propertyDescriptors.description: Initial output volume for synthesized soundtrack.

propertyDescriptors.name: SoundChipProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Sound Chip Profile
propertyDescriptors.description: Aesthetic synthesis flavor (OPL3 DOS, Genesis FM, PC98 FM, NES Chiptune).

propertyDescriptors.name: LowpassCutoff
propertyDescriptors.label: Master Filter Cutoff (Hz)
propertyDescriptors.description: Master resonant lowpass filter cutoff frequency.

propertyDescriptors.name: AutoPlayMidi
propertyDescriptors.label: Auto-play MIDI File
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional MIDI file name or URL to play on scene start.

eventsFunctions.name: onCreated
eventsFunctions.description: Initializes spatial emitter node.

eventsFunctions.name: onDestroy
eventsFunctions.description: Detaches spatial emitter node.

eventsFunctions.name: PlayMidiOnObject
eventsFunctions.description: Plays a MIDI file centered spatially on this object.
